headline: Virtual Assistant
summary: Virtual assistant for Australian and US small businesses, formerly a hotel front desk officer. Four years at a Quezon City hotel taught me to juggle reservations, guests and schedules; for the past year I have managed clients' calendars, inboxes and bookings remotely. I am reliable across time zones and very organised in Google Workspace.

experience.title: Virtual Assistant
experience.employer: self-employed, clients in Australia and the United States
bullets: Manage calendars and inboxes for a Sydney physiotherapy clinic and a Texas real-estate agent.
Book, confirm and reschedule about 150 client appointments a month.
Built shared Google Calendar and Sheets templates so clients see bookings and payments in one place.

experience.title: Front Desk Officer
bullets: Checked in and out up to 120 guests a day and handled walk-in and online reservations.
Resolved guest concerns at the desk and followed up with housekeeping and maintenance.
Trained four new front desk staff on the reservation system.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
